shots.title: Sign in
shots.text: Email and password. There is no public sign-up: accounts come from invite links.

shots.title: Invite created
shots.text: The one-time invite link, to copy and send by hand. With SETTINGS_ENC_KEY set it can be copied again later.

shots.title: Reset link created
shots.text: A one-time password reset link for a user, valid for 24 hours.

shots.title: Invite link
shots.text: A one-time invite opens this form: name, email and password, then the new user is signed in.

shots.title: Reset link
shots.text: An admin-issued one-time link that sets a new password and signs the user out everywhere.

shots.title: Not found
shots.text: Unknown pages, and admin pages for anyone who is not an admin.

shots.title: Add gallery
shots.text: Drop or choose JPEG, PNG or WebP images and ZIP files, mixed in one upload. The limits in effect are shown in the drop zone.

shots.title: Files chosen
shots.text: The list shows every chosen image and ZIP file, with a summary of the count and size, before the upload starts.

shots.title: Adding images
shots.text: The upload is processed in the background. This page refreshes itself and opens the gallery when it is ready.

shots.title: Edit a gallery
shots.text: Title, description, the ZIP switch, grid text, share theme and image view; each image with its title and caption, drag to reorder or Up and Down, Delete; the share link with Copy and Revoke; add more images; Move to Trash.

shots.title: Shared gallery
shots.text: What anyone with the link sees: the title, description, a card grid with titles and captions, and Download ZIP when it is allowed. Nothing about the owner.

shots.title: Lightbox
shots.text: A click opens the image large, with previous and next, arrow keys, Esc, a thumbnail strip, Save and Copy image link.

shots.title: Theme: Frame
shots.text: A white card with a soft shadow on a faint purple-grey page, and the photo count under the title.

shots.title: Theme: Dark wall
shots.text: A deep navy panel with a purple glow, a white title and thumbnails with a fine light edge.

shots.title: Theme: App window
shots.text: A window with the gallery title in its title bar; the description, photo count and ZIP button sit inside.

shots.title: Theme: Polaroid
shots.text: A warm dotted board with every image in a white instant-photo frame, tilted a little left or right.

shots.title: Theme: Glass
shots.text: A frosted-glass panel on a dark page with purple, cyan and pink glows.

shots.title: Theme: Paper stack
shots.text: A white card with two purple-tinted sheets stacked behind it and a dashed line under the title.

shots.title: Image page
shots.text: With the Image page view each image has a page of its own in the gallery’s theme: Back to gallery, “Photo 2 of 24”, Previous and Next (disabled at the ends, arrow keys too), Save and Copy image link.

shots.title: Unsaved changes
shots.text: Changes wait for Save gallery: the bar at the bottom counts them, and an image marked with Delete fades with “Deleted when you save” until it is saved, undone or discarded.

shots.title: Leave without saving?
shots.text: With unsaved changes, a link or another button that would leave the page asks first: Stay on this page, or Leave without saving.

shots.title: Shared single image
shots.text: A gallery with one image shows it embedded with its title, caption and Copy image link; a click opens it in a new tab.

shots.title: Link not available
shots.text: The same page for a revoked link, a gallery in Trash, a disabled owner, sharing turned off or a made-up address.

shots.title: Files not added
shots.text: Files that are not JPEG, PNG or WebP images are listed once by name; the good images are kept.

shots.title: Dashboard
shots.text: Galleries, images, storage used and live share links, the most recent galleries and the latest activity.

shots.title: My activity
shots.text: Your own actions and what happened to your galleries and account: visits, ZIP downloads and an admin’s changes, coloured by what happened.

shots.title: My galleries
shots.text: Every gallery of this user with its cover, image count and size; shared ones carry a pill.

shots.title: Trash
shots.text: Deleted galleries wait here for 30 days: restore one, delete it forever, or empty the whole Trash. Their links stop working meanwhile.

shots.title: Account
shots.text: Change your own password.

shots.title: Overview
shots.text: Users, galleries, images, storage on disk, live share links, the largest galleries and the newest activity.

shots.title: Activity
shots.text: Everything that happened across the app, newest first, with who, what, details and the IP address and browser; filter by person, area or gallery.

shots.title: Users
shots.text: Everyone with an account, their role and status.

shots.title: User detail
shots.text: Issue a reset link, disable or enable the account, change the role, or delete the user.

shots.title: Delete a user
shots.text: Deleting asks for confirmation first and removes the user’s galleries and images.

shots.title: The .env admin
shots.text: The owner account is managed in .env, so it cannot be disabled, demoted or deleted here.

shots.title: Invites
shots.text: Create invites for users or admins; list them as pending, used, expired or revoked.

shots.title: Galleries
shots.text: Every user’s galleries with owner, size and share state; Edit opens the same edit view the owner has.

shots.title: Edited by an admin
shots.text: An admin can remove a single image or fix a title; the owner then sees an “Edited by an admin” pill.

shots.title: Shared links
shots.text: Every live link with its owner, gallery, views, last opened and status, plus View, Details and Revoke.

shots.title: Share link details
shots.text: One link with its latest page views and ZIP downloads: time, IP address and a shortened user-agent.

shots.title: Settings
shots.text: Override switches for items per page, every upload limit, grid text, the share theme and the image view; the public sharing switch; and what is in effect now.

shots.title: Admin account
shots.text: The .env admin’s password is managed in .env, so the form is replaced by a note.
